title: Customer segments and treatments
question: Which groups of customers behave alike, and which treatment should each group get?
story: {members} customers fall into {segments} segments worth {value} a year.
questions: Which segment is worth the most per customer?
Which segment lost the most customers to another since the last run?

datasets.name: records
datasets.sql: SELECT o.record_key, o.entity_id, o.entity_label, o.priority_tier, o.`rank`, o.top_reasons, o.recommended_action, o.value, o.as_of_date, a.segment, s.label AS segment_label, c.region, c.channel, c.plan_type FROM main.sales.customer_segments_out AS o JOIN main.sales.customer_segments_out__assign AS a ON a.entity = o.entity_id JOIN main.sales.customer_segments_out__segments AS s ON s.segment_id = a.segment JOIN main.sales.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.entity_id WHERE o.is_current AND o.change_source <> 'delete'

datasets.name: segments
datasets.sql: SELECT s.segment_id, s.label, s.size, s.value, s.profile, CASE WHEN s.value >= 900 THEN 'Loyalty upgrade' WHEN s.size >= 300 THEN 'Win-back offer' ELSE 'Leave as is' END AS suggested_treatment FROM main.sales.customer_segments_out__segments AS s

datasets.name: profile
datasets.sql: SELECT a.segment, s.label, f.feature, f.score FROM main.sales.customer_segments_out__assign AS a JOIN main.sales.customer_segments_out__segments AS s ON s.segment_id = a.segment JOIN main.sales.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.entity LATERAL VIEW stack(4, 'Orders a year', c.orders_per_year, 'Basket size', c.avg_basket, 'Months as a customer', c.tenure_months, 'Days since last order', c.days_since_last_order) f AS feature, score

datasets.name: members
datasets.sql: SELECT a.entity, a.segment, a.x, a.y, s.label FROM main.sales.customer_segments_out__assign AS a JOIN main.sales.customer_segments_out__segments AS s ON s.segment_id = a.segment

datasets.name: moves
datasets.sql: SELECT m.from_segment, m.to_segment, m.`count` AS moved, f.label AS from_label, t.label AS to_label FROM main.sales.customer_segments_out__migration AS m JOIN main.sales.customer_segments_out__segments AS f ON f.segment_id = m.from_segment JOIN main.sales.customer_segments_out__segments AS t ON t.segment_id = m.to_segment

charts.title: What sets each segment apart
charts.hint: Each axis is one trait, scaled so the highest segment reaches the edge.
charts.so_what: Pick the treatment from the trait that stands out most.

charts.title: Customers by segment
charts.hint: Each dot is a customer, placed so similar customers sit close.
charts.so_what: Dots far from their group are the least sure fit: check them before treating.

charts.title: Segment size and value
charts.hint: Box size is the number of customers; color is the value per customer.
charts.so_what: A big dark box is where a treatment earns the most.

charts.title: Where customers moved since the last run
charts.hint: Each band is the customers who moved from one segment to another.
charts.so_what: A wide band into a low-value segment is the churn to stop first.

tables.title: Segments
tables.hint: Choose a treatment for each segment once: every customer in it gets it.

records.title: Customers
records.hint: Customers from the latest run, ranked by their yearly value.
records.label: entity_label
